question: Does turn_decile (liquidity/size rank) grade episodic pivots, or are EPs already all large/liquid names so size adds nothing? Expect little-to-no effect since EP triggers require extreme volume already.
plain: Episodic pivots are extreme-volume gap events; this checks whether bigger, more liquid stocks among them do better than smaller/thinner ones, or whether size stops mattering once a stock already has that much volume.
